## #4 — frank beckmann — 2007-06-26
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1864/post-12764>

Are you sure?
Applications->Cheetah3d->scripts->Macro/Polygonobj/Splineobj/Tag/Tool

In every folder should be at least one script otherwise you didn´t install Cheetah3d properly.
